title: When the Regiment Burns
author: Paloma Villalobos
blurb: Beatrix Vane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
